literal: Mind purity, action done purity, both, company purity depending on will come.
translation: Purity of mind and purity of action—both will come depending on the purity of one's company.
modern: மனத்தின் தூய்மை, செய்யும் செயலின் தூய்மை ஆகிய இரண்டும் ஒருவன் சேர்ந்திருக்கும் கூட்டத்தின் தூய்மையைச் சார்ந்தே உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how deeply a person's associates influence their inner and outer life. It pairs 'மனம் தூய்மை' (purity of mind) with 'செய்வினை தூய்மை' (purity of action), showing that good thoughts and good deeds go together. The word 'தூவா' means 'depending on' or 'supported by'. Thus, the text asserts that these two virtues are not entirely independent, but arise and are sustained by the purity of the company one keeps.
